research.facts:
Baku Grand Prix Preview
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Race date: Saturday, September 26, 2026 (first Saturday Baku race — scheduling shift due to Azerbaijan National Day of Mourning)
- Practice sessions: FP1+FP2 Sept. 24; FP3+Qualifying Sept. 25
- Circuit: Baku City Circuit, 6.003 km street circuit
- Main straight: 2.2 km at approx. 340 kph
- Norris is the favorite for pole and race victory — McLaren have new Baku parts (improved second sector pace)
- Mercedes saving major upgrade package for Malaysia (next race after Baku)
- George Russell has 3 podiums from last 4 Baku appearances (HIGH — from race preview sources)
- Antonelli leads championship by 81 points over Russell heading into Baku
**Sources:** Sky Sports F1, Coffee Corner Motorsport preview, bets.com.au analysis, Vegas Odds preview

research.facts:
Antonelli Championship Math
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Current standings after R14: Antonelli 292 pts, Russell 211 (-81), Hamilton 191 (-101), Norris 186 (-106)
- 8 wins, 6 poles, 12 podiums in 14 races; 20.9 pts/race average
- Still 19 years old (turns 20 in November)
- Won last two races including drive from 19th at Monza
- Singapore GP (Oct. 9-11) is earliest possible clinch
- Singapore is a SPRINT weekend; sprint race adds extra points
- Singapore clinch scenario: Antonelli max points Baku + sprint win Singapore = 139-pt lead; then needs only 12 pts in Singapore race Sunday
- Sebastian Vettel youngest champion record: 23 years, 134 days; Antonelli clinch at ~20yr 2mo would shatter by 3+ years
**Sources:** Planet F1 title permutations, Motorsport.com standings, Formula1.com, ESPN results

research.facts:
Singapore GP Preview
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Singapore GP: October 9-11, 2026
- Circuit: Marina Bay Street Circuit, 4.9 km, 19 turns
- Sprint weekend format: sprint race + full Grand Prix
- First night race in F1 history (2008)
- 62-lap grand prix, physically demanding, humid conditions; drivers lose up to 3kg
- Grand Prix Season Singapore events: Oct. 2-11 (city-wide events)
- Clinch math: If Antonelli takes max Baku points + Singapore sprint win = 139-pt lead; needs 12 pts Sunday to clinch
**Sources:** F1 Fandom wiki, RaceFans.net, F1 Experiences, Singapore GP official site
